text:
Thoughts
expand_more
An audit of the primary extractions against the facsimile pages of Henry Barclay Swete’s The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint (Vol. I: Genesis–IV Kings, 3rd ed., Cambridge, 1901) across all twelve B001 items yields the following findings
1
2
.
Audit Verdict
CORRECTIONS REQUIRED
Itemized Corrections
1. Punctuation Mark in Deuteronomy 21:23 (Page 386)
Previous Extraction: The target clause in Deuteronomy 21:23 was punctuated with an intermediate high point (·) before the coordinate clause: ὅτι κεκαταραμένος ὑπὸ θεοῦ πᾶς κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου· καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε...
Source Reading: The printed text on page 386 uses a Greek colon (:) at the clause boundary: ὅτι κεκαταραμένος ὑπὸ θεοῦ πᾶς κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου: καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε...
3
.
Correction: Amend the clause punctuation from a high point (·) to a colon (:) to reflect Swete's printed text
3
.
2. Unaccented Apparatus Typography
Previous Extraction: In narrative discussions, apparatus readings were occasionally rendered with standard accents.
Source Reading: Swete’s apparatus prints Greek variant readings strictly without accents or breathings (e.g., 24 τη γυναικι] προς την γυναικα DE on page 4
4
; 23 ου κοιμ.] ουκ επικοιμ. AF | αυτο] αυτον AF | κεκατηραμενος AF | ου 2°] + μη AF | μιανειτε] μιανειται A μιανηται F on page 386
3
).
Correction: Explicitly preserve Swete's convention of unaccented, unbreathed Greek typography for all apparatus citations
3
4
.
Detailed Verification of All 12 B001 Items
A. The 5 Present Pentateuch Passages
Genesis 15:6 (B001-1)
Printed Page: Page 23
5
.
Printed Text: 6 καὶ ἐπίστευσεν Ἀβρὰμ τῷ θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.
5
.
Base Witness: Codex Alexandrinus (A)
5
. Codex Vaticanus (B) has a known lacuna across Genesis 1:1–46:28
6
, and Codex Bodleianus (E) is lacking from Genesis 14:7 to 18:24
7
. The margin indicates (A) (D)
5
.
Apparatus Verification: Absence directly observed
5
. The apparatus on page 23 records notes for 14:20, 21, 23, 24 and 15:1, 7, 10, 12, with no entry occurring for verse 6
5
.
Genesis 2:24 (B001-9)
Printed Page: Page 4
4
.
Printed Text: 24 ἕνεκεν τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ προσκολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.
4
.
Base Witness: Codex Alexandrinus (A)
4
.
Apparatus Verification: Directly observed
4
. The entry reads: 24 τη γυναικι] προς την γυναικα DE
4
. The target quotation clause (καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν) has no apparatus entry and is attested without variation across all collated witnesses (A, D, E)
4
.
Deuteronomy 25:4 (B001-10)
Printed Page: Page 392
8
.
Printed Text: 4 Οὐ φιμώσεις βοῦν ἀλοῶντα.
8
.
Base Witness: Codex Vaticanus (B); collated witnesses in the margin are AF (Codex Alexandrinus and Codex Ambrosianus)
8
.
Apparatus Verification: Absence directly observed
8
. The apparatus notes skip directly from chapter 25, verse 3 to verse 5 (XXV 1 ... 2 ... 3 ... 5 ...), containing no entry for verse 4
8
.
Exodus 32:6 (B001-11)
Printed Page: Page 169
9
.
Printed Text: 6 καὶ ὀρθρίσας τῇ ἐπαύριον ἀνεβίβασεν ὁλοκαυτώματα, καὶ προσήνεγκεν θυσίαν σωτηρίου· καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν.
9
.
Base Witness: Codex Vaticanus (B); collated witnesses in the margin are AF
9
.
Apparatus Verification: Directly observed
9
. The notes record:
5–6 plurima mutila in F
9
6 ορθρισας] + ο.....F* (om ο F?) | θυ... F | πειν B* (πιειν Bab A)
9
. The narrative quotation clause contains the singular verb ἐκάθισεν, the collective noun ὁ λαός, coordinate infinitives (φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν, with B
∗
 spelling πειν), and the plural verb ἀνέστησαν governing παίζειν
9
.
Deuteronomy 21:23 (B001-12)
Printed Page: Page 386
3
.
Printed Text: 23 οὐ κοιμηθήσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ ξύλου, ἀλλὰ ταφῇ θάψετε αὐτὸ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ, ὅτι κεκαταραμένος ὑπὸ θεοῦ πᾶς κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου: καὶ οὐ μιανεῖτε τὴν γῆν ἣν Κύριος ὁ θεός σου δίδωσίν σοι ἐν κλήρῳ.
3
.
Base Witness: Codex Vaticanus (B); collated witnesses in the margin are AF
3
.
Apparatus Verification: Directly observed
3
. The apparatus reads:
23 ου κοιμ.] ουκ επικοιμ. AF | αυτο] αυτον AF | κεκατηραμενος AF | ου 2°] + μη AF | μιανειτε] μιανειται A μιανηται F
3
. The divine agency phrase ὑπὸ θεοῦ is unanimously retained by all witnesses (B, A, and F)
3
.
B. The 7 Absent Prophetic Passages
Romans 9:25 / Hosea 2:23
Romans 9:26 / Hosea 1:10
Romans 10:11 / Isaiah 28:16
Romans 10:13 / Joel 2:32
